Match ‘’ ‘comp’ arguments <- match.arg() comp <- match.arg(comp) ## nselect ‘burst’ (== “burst”) { ## Frequency id tx <- table(id(x)) ## freq validate comparison? comp <- sapply(paste(tx, comp, n), function(t) eval(parse(text = t))) ## FALSE, return NULL ((comp == FALSE)) return() ## Otherwise, extract TRUEs tx <- names(tx)[comp] x[id(x) %% tx] } ## nselect ‘loc’ else (== “loc”) { ## Frequency locs burst nx <- sapply(x, nrow) ## ‘na.rm == TRUE’ compares number non-NAs (na.rm == TRUE) nx <- nx - sapply(x, function() sum(.na([, 1]))) ## freq validate comparison? comp <- sapply(paste(nx, comp, n), function(t) eval(parse(text = t))) ## FALSE, return NULL ((comp == FALSE)) return() ## Otherwise, extract TRUEs x[comp] } } check kselect overlap (Cyril Milleret 2016/02) acf.test expect factors id: acf.test <- function (residuals, id, type = c(“correlation”, “covariance”, “partial”), ci = 0.95) { type <- match.arg(type) acfk <- lapply(unique(factor(id)), function(x) acf(residuals[id == x], type = type, plot = FALSE)) threshold <- unlist(lapply(acfk, function(x) qnorm((1 + ci)/2)/sqrt(xn.used)))lag<−unlist(lapply(1:length(acfk),function()(acfk[[]]n.used)))     lag <- unlist(lapply(1:length(acfk), function() (acfk[[]]acf < threshold[])[1])) return(list(acfk = acfk, threshold = threshold, lag = lag)) } rdSteps: Speed function: bottleneck rbind (use matrices, data.table dplyr) Fix bug bursts relative angles Fix bug steps dist == 0 See email Elisabeth White (2016-07-28 14:50: “Re: Raster Database question”) data+script ‘LizWhite’. closest: see package ‘nabor’ get distance voter closest polling place, syntax : library(nabor) knn.results = knn(data=coordinates(polling.places), query=coordinates(voters), k=1) interloc-functions.R trajdyn + plot.ltraj, replace ‘id’ ‘adehabitatLT::id’ avoid confusion (e.g.) plyr::id trajdyn, plist/llist, cbind ppar/lpar x kfoldRSF – bug step id repeated (instance per animal) (see Justine Smith, 2019-11-07) – RSF : Integrate kfold Nico – Fails NAs case, NAs random (see Michel Kohl, 2014-11-20) scatter.enfa trajdyn, plist/llist, cbind ppar/lpar x circular density: http://freakonometrics.hypotheses.org/20403 (see ‘basr’?) print.ltraj time zones print.ltraj <- function(x, …) { (!inherits(x, “ltraj”)) stop(“x class "ltraj"”) pr <- summary(x) cat(“********** List class ltraj ***********”) (attr(x, “typeII”)) { cat(“Type traject: Type II (time recorded)”) ## Beginning modification tzone <- attr(x[[1]]$date, "tzone")         (.null(tzone) | identical(tzone, ""))             cat("Time zone unspecified; dates printed user time zone\n")         else             cat(paste0("Time zone: ", tzone, "\n"))         ## End modification         (attr(x, "regular")) {             cat(paste("Regular traject. Time lag two locs:",                 mean(x[[1]]$dt, na.rm = TRUE), “seconds”)) } else { cat(paste(“Irregular traject. Variable time lag two locs”)) } } (!attr(x, “typeII”)) { cat(“Type traject: Type (time recorded)”) } cat(“bursts:”) print(pr) cat(“”) (!.null(infolocs(x))) { cat(“infolocs provided. following variables available:”) print(names(infolocs(x)[[1]])) } } count.points: bug SPDF one column (see Cyril Milleret 2015-08-30 Re: aide erreur fonction Kselect) count.points <- function (xy, w) { ((w, “SpatialGrid”)) fullgrid(w) = FALSE (!inherits(w, “SpatialPixels”)) stop(“w inherit class SpatialPixels”) (!inherits(xy, “SpatialPoints”)) stop(“xy inherit class SpatialPoints”) pfsx <- proj4string(w) pfsxy <- proj4string(xy) (!identical(pfsx, pfsxy)) stop(“different proj4string w xy”) gr <- gridparameters(w) (nrow(gr) > 2) stop(“w defined two dimensions”) ((gr[1, 2] - gr[2, 2]) > get(“.adeoptions”, envir = .adehabitatMAEnv)$epsilon) stop(“cellsize x y directions”) (ncol(coordinates(xy)) > 2) stop(“xy defined two dimensions”) meth <- “one” (inherits(xy, “SpatialPointsDataFrame”)) { (ncol(xy) == 1) { meth = “sev” } else { meth = “one” warning(“several columns SpatialPointsDataFrame, id considered”) } } (meth == “one”) { ov <- (xy, geometry(w)) oo <- table(ov) repo <- rep(0, length(w[[1]])) repo[.numeric(names(oo))] <- oo repo <- data.frame(x = repo) coordinates(repo) <- coordinates(w) gridded(repo) <- TRUE (!.na(pfsx)) proj4string(repo) <- CRS(pfsx) return(repo) } else { id <- factor(xy[[1]]) xy2 <- .data.frame(coordinates(xy)) lixy <- split(xy2, id) cp <- lapply(lixy, function(x) { count.points(SpatialPoints(x, proj4string = CRS(proj4string(xy))), w) }) cp <- .call(“data.frame”, lapply(cp, function(x) x[[1]])) coordinates(cp) <- coordinates(w) gridded(cp) <- TRUE (!.na(pfsx)) proj4string(cp) <- CRS(pfsx) return(cp) } } subsample(): Bug single-column data frames https://github.com/ClementCalenge/adehabitatLT/issues/2 subsample.fixed <- function (ltraj, dt, nlo = 1, units = c(“sec”, “min”, “hour”, “day”), …) { (!inherits(ltraj, “ltraj”)) stop(“ltraj class "ltraj"”) ((!.regular(ltraj)) & (attr(ltraj, “typeII”))) stop(“ltraj type type II regular”) p4s <- adehabitatLT:::.checkp4(ltraj) (length(nlo) == 1) nlo <- rep(nlo, length(ltraj)) units <- match.arg(units) dt <- adehabitatLT:::.convtime(dt, units) dtb <- ltraj[[1]]$dt[1] (dt%%dtb != 0) stop(“dt multiple previous time lag”) la <- dt/dtb res <- lapply(1:length(ltraj), function() { x <- ltraj[[]] infol <- attr(x, “infolocs”) vec <- rep(1:la, length = nrow(x)) x <- x[vec == nlo[], ] (!.null(infol)) { ## : infol <- infol[vec == nlo[], , drop = FALSE] attr(x, “infolocs”) <- infol } return(x) }) class(res) <- c(“ltraj”, “list”) attr(res, “typeII”) <- attr(ltraj, “typeII”) attr(res, “regular”) <- .regular(res) attr(res, “proj4string”) <- p4s res <- rec(res, …) return(res) }

title: Working with Trajectories in 2D Space: the Class ltraj — as.ltraj
text: xy data.frame containing x y coordinates relocations. date trajectories type II, vector class POSIXct giving date relocation. trajectories type , argument taken account. id Either character string indicating identity animal factor length equal nrow(xy)/ burst Either character string indicating identity burst relocations factor length equal nrow(xy). typeII Logical. TRUE indicates trajectory type II (time recorded, e.g. radio-tracking), whereas FALSE indicates trajectory type (time recorded, e.g. sampling tracks snow). slsp character string used computation turning angles. infolocs NULL, data frame containing additionnal information relocations (e.g., precision). default, primary key generated. proj4string object class CRS storing projection information relocations.

title: Conversion of the class ltraj to the package sp — ltraj2spdf
text: Modified versions ltraj2spdf ltraj2sldf, allows aggregate burst (default), id, step (parameter "").

title: Conversion of the class ltraj to the package sp — ltraj2spdf
code: ltraj2spdf(ltr, strict = TRUE)  ltraj2sldf(ltr, by = c("burst", "id", "step"), strict = TRUE)

title: Conversion of the class ltraj to the package sp — ltraj2spdf
text: ltr object class ltraj. strict Logical (TRUE default). See ld. ltraj2sldf, applies = "step". Sets level aggregation: id, one object class Lines corresponds one animal; burst (default), corresponds one burst; step, corresponds one step.

title: Conversion of the class ltraj to the package sp — ltraj2spdf
text: conversion SLDF using = "step" significantly longer, factor ~50, two (takes 10 sec 10,000 steps modern computer).
